text_block_list.text:
Ah, this feels nice... I'm so fired up, even
my
fingertips're getting hot.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! As if! I'm burnin' up with
anticipation for
the fierce battle ahead!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm letting a repeat of
last time
happen!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: And I'll prove it to you right now!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
